## Compare 16s/ITS versus ME-NMR 

```{r, eval=FALSE}
phyXlong <- phyX %>% 
  subset_samples(!str_detect(Sample.name,'poz')) %>% 
  subset_samples(!str_detect(Sample.name,'neg')) %>% 
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x)) %>% 
  filter_taxa(function(x) sum(x > 0)>10, TRUE) %>% 
  psmelt() %>%
  gather(mtb,val,X2.hydroxybutyric.acid:valine) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(mtb,'EREC')) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(mtb,'TSP'))


tb_cor <- phyXlong %>% 
  group_by(OTU,mtb,ta1,ta2,ta3,ta4,ta5,ta6,ta7) %>% 
  do(cor.test(data = ., ~val + Abundance,method = 'spearman') %>% tidy)

tb_lmer <- phyXlong %>% 
  group_by(OTU,mtb,ta1,ta2,ta3,ta4,ta5,ta6,ta7) %>% 
  do(lmer(data = ., val ~ log(Abundance+0.0001) + (1|Participant)) %>% tidy)

tb_lmer %>% filter(str_detect(term,'log')) %>% arrange(p.value)


save(file = 'microbiome_vs_nmr_models.RData', list = c('tb_lmer'))
```

### Multivariate prediciton models using nested-cv

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(caret)
library(nestedcv)

make_loio_folds <- function(ids) {
  if (anyNA(ids)) {
    stop("ids must not contain missing values")
  }
  
  ids <- as.character(ids)
  n_ids <- length(unique(ids))
  
  if (n_ids < 3L) {
    stop("At least three unique IDs are required for nested leave-one-ID-out CV")
  }
  
  # Outer test folds: indices refer to rows in the complete dataset
  outer_folds <- split(
    seq_along(ids),
    factor(ids, levels = unique(ids))
  )
  
  # Inner test folds: indices refer to rows in each outer-training dataset
  inner_folds <- lapply(outer_folds, function(outer_test) {
    outer_train <- setdiff(seq_along(ids), outer_test)
    train_ids   <- ids[outer_train]
    
    split(
      seq_along(train_ids),
      factor(train_ids, levels = unique(train_ids))
    )
  })
  
  list(
    outer_folds = unname(outer_folds),
    inner_folds = lapply(inner_folds, unname)
  )
}


```

#### From 16s to NMR

```{r, eval=FALSE}
phyXpp <- phyX %>% 
  subset_samples(!is.na(Sample.ID)) %>% 
  subset_samples(!is.na(X2.hydroxyisovaleric.acid)) %>% 
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x)) %>% 
  filter_taxa(function(x) sum(x > 0)>10, TRUE) 

X <- phyXpp@otu_table %>% data.frame()
Y <- phyXpp@sam_data %>% data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(-TSP,-ERECTIC)

folds <- make_loio_folds(Y$Participant)

unmet <- unique(MEconc_newlong$met) 
unmet <- unmet[!(unmet %in% c("ERECTIC","TSP"))]
# unmet <- unmet[10:length(unmet)]
# unmet <- unmet[30:length(unmet)]
# unmet <- unmet[52:length(unmet)]
unmet <- unmet[89:length(unmet)]
for (i in unmet){
  # i <- unmet[9]
  print(i)
  
  yy <- MEconc_newlong %>% filter(met==i) %>% filter(!is.na(Participant)) %>% filter(`Blood origen`=='ME') 
  
  YY <- Y %>% 
    left_join(yy, by = c('Participant','Period','Cycle.day' = 'Cycle day'))
  
  y <- YY$logy
  sdy <- sd(y)
  
  fit <- nestedcv::nestcv.train(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    method = "spls",                  # any caret model
    preProc = c("center", 'scale'),
    tuneGrid = expand.grid(K = 1:5,# K sets number of components
                           eta = seq(0,1,0.1), # eta sets sparsity
                           kappa = 0.5),
    outer_folds = folds$outer_folds,
    inner_folds = folds$inner_folds,
    finalCV = FALSE,
    cv.cores = 1
  )
  
  fit$sdy <- sdy
  fit$metabolite <- i
  
  flnm <- paste('./MLresults/metabolite_16smodels_nestedcv',
                i %>% 
                  gsub('-','',x = .) %>% 
                  gsub(' ','',x = .) %>% 
                  gsub(',','',x = .),
                '_v2.RData', sep = '')
  save(file = flnm, list = c('fit','i'))
}

```


#### From ITS to NMR

```{r, eval = F}
library(caret)
phyITSpp <- phyITS %>% 
  subset_samples(!is.na(Sample.ID)) %>% 
  subset_samples(!is.na(X2.hydroxyisovaleric.acid)) %>% 
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) as.numeric(x>0)) %>% 
  filter_taxa(function(x) sum(x > 0)>9, TRUE) 

X <- phyITSpp@otu_table %>% data.frame()
Y <- phyITSpp@sam_data %>% data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(-TSP,-ERECTIC)

folds <- make_loio_folds(Y$Participant)

unmet <- unique(MEconc_newlong$met) 
unmet <- unmet[!(unmet %in% c("ERECTIC","TSP"))]
unmet <- unmet[131:length(unmet)]
for (i in unmet){
  # i <- unmet[9]
  print(i)
  
  yy <- MEconc_newlong %>% filter(met==i) %>% filter(!is.na(Participant)) %>% filter(`Blood origen`=='ME') 
  
  YY <- Y %>% 
    left_join(yy, by = c('Participant','Period','Cycle.day' = 'Cycle day'))
  
  y <- YY$logy
  sdy <- sd(y)
  
  fit <- nestedcv::nestcv.train(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    method = "spls",                  # any caret model
    preProc = c("center", 'scale'),
    tuneGrid = expand.grid(K = 1:2,# K sets number of components
                           eta = seq(0,1,0.1), # eta sets sparsity
                           kappa = 0.5),
    outer_folds = folds$outer_folds,
    inner_folds = folds$inner_folds,
    finalCV = FALSE,
    cv.cores = 1
  )
  
  fit$sdy <- sdy
  fit$metabolite <- i
  
  flnm <- paste('./MLresultsITS/metabolite_ITSmodels_nestedcv',
                i %>% 
                  gsub('-','',x = .) %>% 
                  gsub(' ','',x = .) %>% 
                  gsub(',','',x = .),
                '_v2.RData', sep = '')
  save(file = flnm, list = c('fit','i'))
}

```


```{r, eval=FALSE}

flnm <- list.files('./MLresults16s/')
res16s <- data.frame()
for (fl in flnm){
  load(file = paste('./MLresults16s/',fl,sep = ''))
  k <- summary(fit)$final_param$K
  s <- summary(fit)$result %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column('stat') %>% 
    mutate(metabolite = i,method = '16s',sdy = fit$sdy, ncomp = k)
  s$x <- as.numeric(s$x)
  res16s <- bind_rows(res16s,s)
}

flnm <- list.files('./MLresultsITS/')
resITS <- data.frame()
for (fl in flnm){
  load(file = paste('./MLresultsITS/',fl,sep = ''))
  k <- summary(fit)$final_param$K
  s <- summary(fit)$result %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column('stat') %>% 
    mutate(metabolite = i,method = 'ITS',sdy = fit$sdy, ncomp = k)
  s$x <- as.numeric(s$x)
  resITS <- bind_rows(resITS,s)
}


load(file = '~/OneDrive - University of Copenhagen/KU_work/menstrual_effluent/multiomics_menstrual_effluent/RMSE0_loio.RData')

MLstat16s <- RMSE0 %>% left_join(res16s %>% filter(stat=='RMSE')) %>% mutate(method = '16s') 
MLstatITS <- RMSE0 %>% left_join(resITS %>% filter(stat=='RMSE'))  %>% mutate(method = 'ITS') 

MLstat <- bind_rows(MLstat16s,MLstatITS) %>% 
  mutate(stat = 'RMSE', 
         ncomp = ifelse(is.na(x),0,ncomp),
         x = ifelse(is.na(x),rmse0,x)) %>% 
  left_join(MEclass, by = c('metabolite' = 'Interval_name')) 

save(file = '~/OneDrive - University of Copenhagen/KU_work/menstrual_effluent/multiomics_menstrual_effluent/MLstats.RData', 
     list = c('MLstat','res16s','resITS'))
```

### Histogram of CV predictive performance

```{r}
# resperm %>% 
# ggplot(data = ., aes(Rsquared)) + geom_histogram() + facet_wrap(~method)

respermsum <- resperm %>% 
  group_by(method) %>% 
  summarise(mn = mean(Rsquared), 
            s = sd(Rsquared))
R2sign_16s <- qnorm(0.95,mean = respermsum$mn[1],sd = respermsum$s[1])
R2sign_ITS <- qnorm(0.95,mean = respermsum$mn[2],sd = respermsum$s[2])

beta <- beta %>%left_join(res, by = c('metabolite','method')) %>% 
  filter(metabolite!='ERECTIC')
```

### Per metabolite - CV predictive perormance.

```{r}
load(file = '~/OneDrive - University of Copenhagen/KU_work/menstrual_effluent/multiomics_menstrual_effluent/MLstats.RData')

MLstat <- MLstat %>% 
  mutate(
    Rsquared = 1 - (x^2 / rmse0^2),
    quality = ifelse(Rsquared < (-0.2),'overfitted','ok'),
    Rsquared = ifelse(Rsquared < (-0.2),-0.2,Rsquared)) 
MLstat %>%
  ggplot(data = ., aes(metabolite,Rsquared, color = method, shape = quality)) + 
  geom_point()
```

Figure 5A in publication

```{r}
library(gplots)

ggbeta <- beta %>% 
  left_join(dflb, by = 'category') %>%
  filter(!(lb %in% 'Other/Bin/Unknown')) %>% 
  mutate(breg = breg/sdy) %>% 
  filter(method == '16s') %>% 
  filter((RMSE / sdy) < 0.75) %>% 
  group_by(metabolite) %>% 
  mutate(nn = sum(abs(breg)>0)) %>% 
  filter(nn>0) %>% 
  group_by(OTU) %>% 
  mutate(nn2 = sum(abs(breg)>0)) %>% 
  filter(nn2>0) %>% 
  left_join(phyX@tax_table %>% data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column('OTU') %>% 
              left_join(bsum16s, by = c('ta2','ta3','ta4','ta5')), by = 'OTU') %>% 
  mutate(OTU = OTU %>% fct_reorder(ta5))

lbs <- ggbeta %>% 
  group_by(OTU) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(lb = ta5[1], 
                   lb4 = ta4[1], 
                   lb3 = ta3[1], 
                   lb2 = ta2[1], 
                   n()) %>% 
  arrange(lb)

# 1) find lowest level of id, 2) remove F__
for (i in which(nchar(lbs$lb)<4)){
  id <- which(nchar(lbs[i,])>4)[1]
  print(as.character(lbs[i,id]))
  lbs$lb[i] <- as.character(lbs[i,id])
}

lbs <- lbs %>% 
  mutate(lb = lb %>% 
           gsub('F__','',x = .) %>% 
           gsub('__','-',x = .))


g5 <- ggbeta %>% 
  # remove bin from mtb label
  mutate(metabolite = gsub('bin.','',x = metabolite)) %>% 
  # filter of only bins / unk
  filter(nchar(metabolite)>6) %>% 
  mutate(metabolite = gsub('X2.','2-',x = metabolite)) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(metabolite,'unk')) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(metabolite,'1_2')) %>% 
  
  ggplot(data = ., aes(metabolite,OTU,fill = breg)) + 
  geom_tile() + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = lbs$lb,breaks =lbs$OTU ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(mid = 'white',midpoint = 0) + 
  theme(legend.position = 'top', axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)) + 
  xlab(NULL) + ylab(NULL)


g_r2
```
